description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named Connectivity, which implements various network testing and management features. It includes functionality for toggling Wi-Fi, scanning for networks, requesting and releasing network capabilities, handling Wi-Fi TDLs, measuring scan times, conducting HTTP/Socket requests over different networks, and scheduling screen/wifi toggles using alarms. The class also interacts with system services such as WifiManager, ConnectivityManager, EthernetManager, and INetworkManagementService for network operations and monitoring.
external_files: R.id.* (various resource IDs used for UI components)

classes.name: DevToolsNetworkCallback
classes.description: Implements the NetworkCallback interface with overridden methods to log network state changes.

classes.name: RequestableNetwork
classes.description: Represents a network request with UI controls for requesting and releasing network capabilities.

classes.name: DevToolsEthListener
classes.description: Listens for Ethernet interface state changes and logs status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers receivers, and system callbacks.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up registered callbacks, receivers, and releases resources.

methods.name: onStartDelayedCycle
methods.description: Starts Wi-Fi toggle cycles with scheduled delays.

methods.name: onStopDelayedCycle
methods.description: Stops Wi-Fi toggle cycles and releases wake lock.

methods.name: onStartScreenCycle
methods.description: Schedules screen on/off cycles via alarms.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm to perform screen on/off toggling after a specified delay.

methods.name: onStopScreenCycle
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping screen cycles (empty implementation).

methods.name: onReportAllBad
methods.description: Reports all available networks as bad to the system.

methods.name: onStartScanCycle
methods.description: Initiates Wi-Fi network scanning cycles, updates UI with results.

methods.name: onStartTdls
methods.description: Enables TDLS for a specified MAC address or IP address.

methods.name: onStopTdls
methods.description: Disables TDLS for the specified address.

methods.name: onLinkStats
methods.description: Fetches Wi-Fi activity energy info asynchronously and updates UI.

methods.name: onHttpRequest
methods.description: Performs HTTP or socket requests over a specified network in a background thread.

methods.name: doSocketRequest
methods.description: Performs a raw socket HTTP GET request to a host.
